description.text: Core courses Political Economy, Western Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Monetary Banking, International Economics, Finance, Econometrics, International Trade, and International Finance. Objective This objective is to train students to be applied talents to do overseas trade and business as well as relevant work in the administrative departments of foreign trade and economic cooperation and foreign-related enterprises. This objective is to train students to be innovative talents who have the solid foundation of economics, have acquaintance with the theory of international economics and trade, and skillfully grasp modern economic analytical methods. Meanwhile, they have relatively wide knowledge, strong scientific research ability, initiative spirit and practice capability. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Economics is granted.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
